C0454.title: Man Sentenced to Ten Years and Six Months for Stealing Funds from 57 Bank Cards in Wenshan
C0454.summary: According to Yunnan Chang'an Net, from November 2018 to September 2019, Li obtained victims' identity details, bank-card information, and verification codes by claiming he could help process credit cards, loans, and credit-limit increases. He then registered or accessed Alipay and UnionPay QuickPass accounts, bound victims' cards, and transferred funds away. Investigators found that 57 victims lost RMB 487,154.32. A court convicted Li of theft and sentenced him to ten years and six months in prison with a RMB 20,000 fine.

references.title: Man stole money from 57 bank cards in Wenshan; operation details disclosed - Yunnan Chang'an Net
